name: jira-assist
description: A fast, local-first sprint planning tool for Jira that allows bulk manipulation of sprint data with snapshot-based workflows.

scripts.install:all: cd sprint-planner/server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install && cd ../..
scripts.dev: npm run install:all && source jira.env && (cd sprint-planner/server && npm start &) && cd sprint-planner/client && npm run dev
